Messages.Author: guntherbl
Messages.Body:
Can I play Fata Morgana at superior even if I do not need stealth (just
to have the +1 bleed effect) ?

Another question: Vampire A is acting, Vampire B blocking: in combat,
Vampire A plays Strike:CE. Shall Vampire B choose his or her strike
anyway or has the combat already ended?

Thank you.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: cantila
Messages.Body:
In article <8teaqo$dpd$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

guntherbl <gunt...@my-deja.com> wrote:
> Can I play Fata Morgana at superior even if I do not need stealth
(just
> to have the +1 bleed effect) ?

No, you cannot increase stealth if it's not needed.

>
> Another question: Vampire A is acting, Vampire B blocking: in combat,
> Vampire A plays Strike:CE. Shall Vampire B choose his or her strike
> anyway or has the combat already ended?

Yes B gets to strike too, so you can cycle cards this way and also
strike with say, Majesty and untap.
